text:
maria: Heads-up: GPU attach latency + a few OOM-like errors in us-west1 for the last 20m. I see routecache eviction logs on gnode-11 coinciding with local SSD IOPS dip. :thinking:
sre-bot: ALERT: attach-latency > 600ms on cluster gpu-fleet-usw2 at 3322223333
jonathan: I'm looking. pulling iostat + dmesg now.
jonathan: ```
iostat -x 1 5
Device:    r/s   w/s  await  r_await w_await svctm  %util
nvme0n1  1200   0.1   5.2     4.9     0.3   0.25  30.5
# note: r/s drops to ~10 after routecache eviction event in dmesg
```
kevin: @maria can you share the grafana panel for attach latency + routecache evictions?
maria: https://grafana.redwood/d/GPU/attach-latency?panelId=7 — overlayed with `net_routecache_evictions` looks like a step down at ~3322223290.
anita: This smells like route cache churn triggering a kernel path re-eval -> transient IO scheduling inversion. Saw something similar in ap-south1 last month. Can we check `sysctl net.ipv4.route_cache_max_size` and any recent TTL changes?
jonathan: dmesg shows repeated "route_cache: flushing" messages and then a burst of `blk_issue` latency. Collecting perf traces now. For immediate mitigation I'd recommend rolling back the routecache TTL tighten from release-32.
kevin: release-32 tightened route cache TTLs. Can we rollback just the network kernel param or do a full release rollback? @ops-lb-bot any constraints for rollback in us-west2?
ops-lb-bot: Rollback window open for next 15m. No dependent rollouts blocking rollback in us-west2.
maria: Rolling back release-32 on gnode-11 and gnode-12 now. Will watch attach queue and NVMe metrics. :shipit:
jonathan: After rollback iostat back to baseline within ~40s, attach latency dropped to ~120ms and attach queue drained. NVMe read r/s recovered and %util normalized.
anita: Follow-ups: add an e2e test that mounts local NVMe and simulates routecache churn; add a dashboard panel correlating `net_routecache_evictions` and `nvme_ops` and include an alert threshold.
maria: Filed INFRA ticket: https://redwood.atlassian/browse/INFRA-9876 — attached perf traces & notes. cc @kevin @jonathan
kevin: :thumbsup: Nice catch everyone. If this surfaces again let's do a short postmortem and decide whether routecache defaults should be region-specific.
